prompt:
Pixel-art ground texture for a top-down JRPG map: tide-pool rock: dark volcanic rock shelves with pools, barnacles and seaweed The square is about 256 x 256 art pixels (each art pixel about 7x7 image pixels).
Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art ("HD pixel art" JRPG look), hand-placed pixels. Every art pixel is a crisp square of the same size across the whole image (about 8x8 image pixels per art pixel). No anti-aliasing, no blur, no soft brushes, no photographic texture, no noise, no dithering checkerboards. Clusters of 3-10 pixels with clear shapes. Hue-shifted colour ramps: shadows lean toward purple/red and are more saturated, highlights lean toward warm yellow. 4-6 shades per material, rich but earthy, worn and lived-in.
Camera: classic top-down RPG map view (seen from above at a steep angle, like a 16-bit era overworld/town map), orthographic, no perspective convergence.
Lighting: neutral, soft, even light from the upper left, like a calm overcast evening; NO cast shadows, NO night darkness, NO light sources, NO glow, NO lamp light pools, NO vignette. (The game engine adds the night lighting on top later, so this must be the clean base colours.)
It must be a SEAMLESS TILEABLE texture: the left edge continues into the right edge and the top edge into the bottom edge. Fill the entire square edge to edge with the surface only: no border, no frame, no objects, no characters, no text, no single focal feature, even distribution of detail.
revised_prompt: Generate a square, seamless tileable top-down JRPG ground texture, tide-pool volcanic shore rock. Dark charcoal volcanic rock shelves with irregular shallow teal-blue tide pools, scattered small ivory barnacle clusters, and short muted olive seaweed strands embedded throughout. Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art: consistent crisp square art pixels approximately 7–8 display pixels wide, visibly hand-placed, no anti-aliasing, blur, soft brushes, photographic texture, noise, or checkerboard dithering. Distinct 3–10 pixel clusters and clear shapes; 4–6 shades per material, earthy rich hue-shifted ramps with purple-red saturated rock shadows and restrained warm yellow rock highlights. Orthographic classic top-down RPG map camera, no perspective. Neutral soft even overcast lighting from upper left, clean base colors, no cast shadows, night darkness, light sources, glow, pools of lamp light or vignette. Fill entire square edge to edge with surface only, uniformly distributed details, no border/frame/objects/characters/text/focal centerpiece. Crucial: seamless periodic repeat on BOTH axes: all shapes intersecting the left boundary exactly continue at the corresponding right boundary, and all shapes intersecting the top boundary exactly continue at the corresponding bottom boundary. Tile texture, not a framed illustration.
